column3: Close to the Hebrew; “what he was to her” is rendered “how he was related to her.”
Close to the Hebrew; “how can I look on” is rendered “how can I endure to see.”
Close to the Hebrew; כּוּשׁ (“Cush”) is rendered “Ethiopia.”
The rare terms for the horses are rendered “royal horses bred from swift steeds”; “the sons of the mares” is interpreted.
Close to the Hebrew; “to stand for their life” is rendered “protect their lives.”
Close to the Hebrew; תְּכֵלֶת (“violet”) is rendered “blue.”
